description:
List this shop's ads, newest first, with what each has done: impressions and taps on the ad card during its run, and the listing's own views and contacts over the ad's days. Ads whose payment was refused are not listed.

Returns `ads`, each with `id`, `listing_id`, `status`, `hours`, `starts_at`, `ends_at`, `impressions`, `clicks`, `listing_views`, `listing_contacts`, `amount_usdc_atomic`, `network` and `tx_hash`.
name: list_ads

ads.description: The shop's ads, newest first (up to 50)

amount_usdc_atomic.description: The price paid, in USDC's smallest unit (6 decimals)

clicks.description: Taps on the ad card during its run (same limit)

ends_at.description: When it ends or ended (ISO 8601); null until paid

hours.description: How many hours it runs, as bought

impressions.description: Times the ad card was at least half on screen for a second, during its run (at most once per visitor per 10 minutes)

listing_contacts.description: Signed-in buyers who opened the seller's contact over the same days; null when not measurable yet

listing_views.description: The listing's page views from the day the ad started (to its end, or now): from daily snapshots, so ad and non-ad visits together. Null when not measurable yet, and always for an ad shorter than a day

starts_at.description: When it started or starts (ISO 8601); null until paid

tx_hash.description: The payment's transaction; null until known

title: List this shop's ads
